chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Dawud ibn Sirhan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who had dinars owed to him by another man, and he transferred him to another man for his dinars, so he takes dirhams with them. Is that permissible?

key_terms.أَ يَجُوزُ: is it permissible according to the legal ruling
key_terms.دَرَاهِمَ: silver coins taken in settlement instead of dinars
key_terms.دَنَانِيرُ: gold coins serving as the original owed amount
key_terms.فَأَحَالَ: he transferred the claim or referred the creditor to another payer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to settle a debt owed in dinars by receiving dirhams through a transfer to another debtor?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a financial transfer involving a debt originally owed in dinars and received in dirhams through referral to another party. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام affirms the permissibility of this arrangement, indicating allowance for such debt settlement in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3409 - Al-Bazanti narrated from Dawood bin Sirhan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who had dinars owed to him by another man, and the debtor transferred the payment obligation to a third man in exchange for dirhams instead of dinars. Is this permissible?
